title: ThinkRail semantic colour layer
description: What each theme-manifest colour is FOR. Palettes themselves live in themes/bundled/*.theme.json; this file is the only place a colour derivation is written. See COLOR.md.

scale.description: The alpha scale. Every tint is one of these steps — a percentage never appears anywhere else.

roles.description: The semantic layer: the names components are allowed to use.

from.description: A theme manifest key (THEME_COLOR_KEYS). The CSS variable it writes to is derived kebab-case, not tabulated: `borderStrong` -> `--border-strong`.

alpha.description: A step of `scale`. Omit for a solid colour.

fallback.description: Used when the manifest value is null (the nullable selection foregrounds).

publish.description: true → a Tailwind utility. false → read directly by Monaco/xterm/mermaid/global.css.

effects.description: Appearance-level values that are not palette derivations: scrims and shadows.
